Initial release of go-surge: Unofficial Go client for Surge SMS API

- Provides typed REST methods to interact with Surge SMS resources: accounts, messages, contacts, campaigns, phone numbers, and more.
- Requires Go and SURGE_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Offers comprehensive security guidance around token handling and real resource modification.
- Supports manual cursor-based pagination and includes usage examples for sending messages.
- Suitable when Go code needs Surge SMS features or already imports github.com/psyb0t/go-surge.
